item.title: Colorado funeral home owner who abused nearly 200 corpses gets 40 years, decried as a 'monster'
item.description: COLORADO SPRINGS, Colo. (AP) — A Colorado funeral home owner who stashed 189 decomposing bodies in a building over four years and gave grieving families fake ashes was sentenced to 40 years in state prison Friday.

item.title: Ex-MLB player Yasiel Puig found guilty of obstruction and lying to federal officials
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — A jury has found former major league outfielder Yasiel Puig guilty of obstruction of justice and lying to federal officials investigating an illegal gambling operation, the U.S. Attorney’s Office said Friday.

item.title: Union files complaints as feds increase public servants' in-office time
item.description: OTTAWA — Canada's largest federal public sector union has filed several unfair labour practice complaints - and another union is warning of a possible strike - as the government moves to increase public servants' in-office time.

item.title: Canadian Tire ordered to pay nearly $1.3 million for false advertising
item.description: MONTREAL — Canadian Tire has been ordered to pay just under $1.3 million after pleading guilty to 74 counts of violating sections of Quebec's Consumer Protection Act related to false advertising.

item.title: Sault Ste. Marie's Algoma makes first plates for the Polar Max icebreaker ships
item.description: The first plates of made-in-Sault Ste. Marie steel were produced today at Algoma Steel — marking the beginning of construction preparations for Canada’s newest icebreaking vessel

item.title: Unemployment rate drops to 6.5% in January despite 25,000 job losses: StatCan
item.description: Statistics Canada says the economy shed 25,000 jobs in January but a drop in the number of people looking for work drove the unemployment rate down to 6.5 per cent in the month

item.title: Bodies found in area in Mexico where search is on for 10 missing workers from Canadian mine
item.description: MEXICO CITY (AP) — Mexican authorities on Friday announced the discovery of bodies and remains in the northwestern state of Sinaloa in an area of an ongoing search for 10 missing workers from a Canadian gold and silver mine.
